sources.title: Malaysia ADM1 simplified geometry
sources.note: Reference geometry represents 2017, build 2023. This is cartographic context, not dated wildlife observations. Selected peninsular features, renamed properties, reversed ring winding for Vega; anchors are largest-polygon planar centroids.

caveats: NWRC Figure 26 bar labels and numeric table disagree in places. The website consistently uses the printed numeric table and discloses this discrepancy.
Federal Territories reporting unit is retained in totals and tables but not allocated to individual territory polygons.
State anchors show regional reporting locations, not precise rescue/release sites. Perak-to-Perak releases are shown separately.
The Sankey and flow map are two views of the same 32 released animals; they must never be summed.
Placement durations are inclusive calendar days, not worked hours or workdays.
Animal GPS data and unverified MyBIS data are excluded.
